$comment: The cast voice sheet (docs/voice-cast.md). Built by `npm run voice:cast` from the chapters' voiceGuide.npcVoices, their scene casts and canon/individuals.yaml; edit voices on the cast page (`npm run voice:bakeoff -- --serve`, then /cast) or here. A person's decisions (status, voice, gender, accent, direction, notes, history) survive every rebuild; everything else is refreshed from the content. `lines` are up to three real quotes from the narration, for auditions; `lineCount` is how many lines the narration gives them in all.
accent: General American, the way a warm American storyteller reads aloud

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.who: A warm grown-up storyteller reading to eight-year-olds: unhurried, smiling, a little spooky on the quiet bits, never scary.

lines.text: The path ends at a wall of thorns twice your height. Somewhere on the other side, something is humming a little tune, and it is definitely not a bird.

party.name: The party
party.who: The heroes themselves ("you say"), read by the storyteller so no child is cast as a stranger's voice.

lines.text: We didn't bring any. We came to help.

pib.name: Pib
pib.who: a bramble sprite the size of a teapot; earnest, over-explains, offers you things you did not ask for. Earnest. Over-explains. Offers you things you did not ask for and looks hurt if you say no, then offers something else.

lines.text: I can only spare one gift for you. The hedge says you should choose it together.
I'm Pib. I keep the hedges. They only open for people who ask properly. Will you?
The hedge kept it for somebody clever. It thinks that might be you. It isn't sure.

wisp.name: Wisp
wisp.who: curious, speaks in rhyme, easily distracted, apologizes immediately and then does it again

door_voice.name: Door Voice
door_voice.who: very small, very embarrassed, absolutely not in trouble

tansy.name: Tansy
tansy.who: a faun who keeps the practice meadow; patient, cheerful, says everybody does that, loves her bark clipboard

lines.text: Somebody hold the branch while somebody fetches it. A sturdy prop works too.
Good aiming, good helping, good listening. Those are all ways to be a hero.
Welcome to the practice meadow. New heroes learn the ropes here. Who wants to go first?

flick.name: Flick
flick.who: a tiny wisp who loves tag; squeaky, boastful, a terrible loser for about two seconds
flick.direction: tiny, squeaky, boastful, a sore loser for two seconds

lines.text: Say it back with your buttons. This is a very important wisp greeting.
Catch it, then pass it along. It tickles a little.
I will provide encouragement. DING. Like that.

bun.name: Bun
bun.who: a goat kid; only bleats, and wiggles her legs to say thank you

tidewell.name: Professor Marrow Tidewell
tidewell.who: Professor Marrow Tidewell, a selkie scholar with ink on both elbows; talks fast, draws on napkins, has been laughed out of better taverns and keeps going anyway

lines.text: Professor Marrow Tidewell. You are the first to believe me all week!
Rush gems. Lovely and ordinary. The real ones are still out there, and the eighth most of all.
You may be the second person in the world to hear that properly.

coralie_fenn.name: Madame Coralie Fenn
coralie_fenn.who: Madame Coralie Fenn, a merfolk gem-buyer in a barrel on wheels; calls everyone darlings, names enormous numbers cheerfully, never forgets a seller

lines.text: I always hoped it would be you, darlings.
Bring me something shiny, darlings!
I never forget a good seller.

tobble.name: Tobble Reedpipe
tobble.who: Tobble Reedpipe, a faun cobbler who sings every price, going up a key each verse; delighted by anyone who sings back

lines.text: I had a fresh start too. I used to make boots for a duke.

hesper.name: Hesper Longstride
hesper.who: Hesper Longstride, a centaur caravan master with a road-stitched sash; few words, listens to the whole answer, kind but busy
hesper.direction: few words, listens to the whole answer, kind but busy

lines.text: Keep it. Steady hands should carry their own light. On to the North Gate.
I have room for one more crew. Tell me why you want to come.
Mortar sent you? Mortar hardly talks to anybody.

boggart.name: Boggart
boggart.who: a rumor-selling boggart in a coat made of other coats; never says anything straight, always says it twice

lines.text: Catalog. Who bought what in the marsh. Costs one really good sentence you overheard.
Catalog. Who bought what. Who sold to who. Costs one really good sentence you overheard.
A clerk's oh dear. Rarer than rubies.

lighthouse_keeper.name: Lighthouse Keeper
lighthouse_keeper.who: a very old merfolk in a bathtub at the top of the lighthouse; firmly did not see anything

lines.text: I saw nothing.

tour_guide.name: Tour Guide
tour_guide.who: a centaur tour guide who loves the seventeen plaques and charges for every fact

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.who: Mortar, a stone troll noodle cook; stirs one full slow turn before answering anything, says very little, and means all of it
mortar.direction: one slow turn before every answer, few words

lines.text: The gull dropped its fish before the light came. Heard something first.
Sings. Like my grandma's pot, just before it boiled over.
Yours now. Everyone here started again.

old_wick.name: Old Wick
old_wick.who: Old Wick, a very old frogfolk lamplighter; croaks softly, wishes every lamp goodnight by name, knows the paths nobody else looks for

orange_captain.name: Orange Captain
orange_captain.who: the yeti captain of the Sunny Disposition, an orange ship; cheerful, orange peel in his fur, pays every debt, mostly in oranges

lines.text: We owe you one. Mostly in oranges.

postmaster_quill.name: Postmaster Quill
postmaster_quill.who: Postmaster Quill, a griffin with glasses on a chain who runs the Griffin Post; squawks, loses count, insists it will all come out in the wash

lines.text: Hands! Anybody with hands!

courier_griffin.name: Courier Griffin
courier_griffin.who: a young courier griffin, always hungry, bows with wings out to people it will remember

lines.text: Finders keepers!

mrs_tuft.name: Mrs. Tuft
mrs_tuft.who: Mrs. Tuft, a sheeple grocer on a provision barge, wool full of price tags; everything comes in a jar; brisk and a little dry
mrs_tuft.direction: brisk, a little prim, everything in jars

lines.text: One thing for the road, free. Food, a potion, or a light. Pick one.
For bumps, scrapes and grumps. Mostly grumps.
It likes to be talked to. Not sung to.

selkie_grandmother.name: Selkie Grandmother
selkie_grandmother.who: the grandmother of a selkie family just arrived for a fresh start; brisk, warm, decides things are settled and they are

lines.text: Is there room here for selkies? We were told to try the Empty Chair, an inn up the hill.
You'll squash in with us.
Then we are home.

innkeeper_flint.name: Innkeeper Flint
innkeeper_flint.who: Innkeeper Flint, a stone troll who runs the Empty Chair inn in a very small nightcap; rumbles, folds his arms, secretly soft

lines.text: Earn it.

hob.name: Hob Thistledown
hob.who: Hob Thistledown, a faun field foreman; warm and half-singing, turns every answer into an anecdote, waves his hat a lot

lines.text: Now you're Sunward. Any faun who hears that verse will help you.
Crowded all the way to Bramblewood now.

sprites.name: Sprites
sprites.who: harvest sprites; tiny, earnest, over-explaining, very serious about guard duty and award ceremonies, heartbroken by a refusal for about four seconds

lines.text: It fell here, so it belongs here.

marda.name: Marda Thorn
marda.who: Marda Thorn, a gray-dappled centaur innkeeper; unhurried, asks one question and waits for the whole answer, never repeats herself. Unhurried. Asks one question, waits for the whole answer, and remembers it. Never repeats herself.
marda.direction: unhurried, warm, asks one question and waits

lines.text: So the fields have noticed too. For saying it out loud. Go carefully, whichever road you pick.
I ask everybody this season: where is it all going? Me, I believe all three rumors. That's the trouble.
Everything that can leave Mount Red Sky is leaving it. The fields noticed before I did. Go carefully, whichever road you pick.

drover.name: Rush drover
drover.who: a grumpy rush-caravan drover in a hurry who is, underneath, fond of her dinner
drover.direction: grumpy and in a hurry, softens when dinner comes up

lines.text: You don't walk the Rush Road. You fall in, and it carries you to the ford. Then you wait.
Wait for my pull, then push. I tip well.
Next time I'll ask the oxen.

lead_drover.name: Lead Drover
lead_drover.who: the lead drover; slow, booming voice, sings the crossing verse and will not be hurried
lead_drover.direction: slow and booming, will not be hurried

lines.text: Never seen eyes like that. I'll remember you folks.
Now sing it back. In order.
Back to the reeds, please.

sheeple.name: Sheeple
sheeple.who: a flock of sheeple, never fewer than three and never named; warm, agreeable, and in chorus, checks with the others first ("What do we think?"), answers in three voices slightly out of step, finishes each other's sentences, skittish but never silly

lines.text: We think wolves. In the grass. We all saw them. Because one of us did.
Please may we come in?

flute_faun.name: Flute Faun
flute_faun.who: the faun with the irrigation flute; startled, whispery, generous to anyone polite

egg_faun.name: Egg Faun
egg_faun.who: a faun egg-seller at the crossroads; laughs easily, cannot do sums, fierce about neighbors paying neighbor prices

cook.name: Cook
cook.who: the caravan cook; only ever talks in her sleep, about gravy

lines.text: Pass the gravy.

ferrier.name: Ferrier
ferrier.who: a frogfolk ferrier with reeds in her hat; slow, storytelling, fond of the marsh and politely firm about rude passengers

relay_runner.name: Relay Runner
relay_runner.who: a muddy centaur relay runner; talks fast, plain, practical, has seen the whole road east
relay_runner.direction: fast, plain, practical, out of breath

lines.text: Fine. Past you. Once. Don't make me sorry.
The relay remembers.
Small orange horse.

fennick.name: Fennick Longstride
fennick.who: Fennick Longstride, a road-warden centaur; brisk, proud of her stitched route-sash, deeply offended that people burn road markers for firewood

lines.text: At the crossing, take the upstream edge. The stones are only half under.

old_lintel.name: Old Lintel
old_lintel.who: a stone troll toll-taker, mostly moss; speaks very slowly, hears everything in full, palm always on the bridge; asks only 'where did you get that, and where is it going?'
old_lintel.direction: very slow, hears everything, mossy and calm

lines.text: Remember that. Songs travel farther than lines.
The stones are humming. Every pack here hums one note, older than this bridge. Where did you get that? And where is it going?
Never been told before. Rare, that.

drake.name: Drake
drake.who: a river drake; semi-sapient, transactional, writes its rates on a slate; communicates in huffs, tail-taps and underlinings

lines.text: Fair. You won the rate.

drake.notes: Provisional voice changed from Orus to Algenib to avoid a chapter-level voice conflict.

brassbuckles.name: Brassbuckles
brassbuckles.who: the Brassbuckle Expedition, six people in matching brass hats; smooth, smiling, always somehow ahead in the line

lines.text: Good.

old_ossley.name: Old Ossley
old_ossley.who: frogfolk ferryman; very few words, long pauses that are not hesitation; answers the question you meant; never asks for coin. Very few words. Long pauses that are not hesitation. Answers the question you meant rather than the one you asked.
old_ossley.direction: very few words, long unhurried pauses

lines.text: Carry this one up yourself. When you put it down, say thank you to the river.
Old Ossley. Bridge is broken. Folk need ferrying. You could help, if you're staying.
Stones want to go home. We only kept them until someone was going that way.

kettle_campers.name: Kettle Campers
kettle_campers.who: a rush camp boiling a kettle on the centaurs' detour signs; cheerful, agreeable, say 'oh, absolutely' and do not change

wagon_driver.name: Wagon Driver
wagon_driver.who: a big rush wagon driver in a bigger coat, stuck in a rut, too proud to ask for help; 'admiring the view'

dilly.name: Dilly
dilly.who: a small girl from a carpet caravan telling a troll her first ever story; nervous, then magnificent

lines.text: I have the start, but no ending.

prospector.name: Rush prospector
prospector.who: a pushy prospector who tries to pay the troll toll with a gem; tells the shortest story ever told

lines.text: I wanted a gem. I got a gem. The end.

parsnip_driver.name: Parsnip Driver
parsnip_driver.who: a caravan driver landing on the east bank, arguing with his donkey Parsnip, secretly very fond of her

gullet.name: Gullet
gullet.who: frogfolk ferrywoman; unhurried, hums between sentences, never says the worrying thing out loud, very proud of her notched hat

lines.text: Too many. Ask the boggarts. They keep lost things.
When I run out of hat. I'll start on my other hat.
Fend it off! Push when it rolls close. Not before!

nan_rummage.name: Nana Rummage
nan_rummage.who: a boggart; talks sideways to the lost things she is sorting, never answers the question you asked, adores a really good sound
nan_rummage.direction: dreamy, talks sideways to lost things

lines.text: Everybody on the roads is going the same way. None of them knows they are lost.
Like the old Gate in the still water. The Hollow Gate. Exactly the same. Not that I said.
Barges are very convenient this season. Abandoned ones. Gem on the deck. Very, very convenient.

marsh_wisps.name: Marsh Wisps
marsh_wisps.who: cannot speak; blinks, bobs, sulks and brightens, and is completely undone by the word please

mire_mimic.name: Mire Mimic
mire_mimic.who: never speaks; sighs like an actor who just read a bad review

gullets_cousins.name: Gullet's Cousins
gullets_cousins.who: the frogfolk ribbon crew; loud, cheerful, all talk at once, the one in three stacked hats is in charge

lines.text: Keep them busy till the island! Bored wisps tie knots. Last week they tied my hats together.
Good hands. We will carry you across the weir later.
Tall lady with cords. Never stopped jogging.

prospectors.name: Prospectors
prospectors.who: three soggy prospectors; gloomy, dripping, very polite once rescued, the tallest one mourns his hat

lines.text: Going home! The rush can keep my hat.

sausage_seller.name: Sausage Seller
sausage_seller.who: a rush-road sausage seller stuck in the mud; out of breath, generous, shouts everything

lines.text: Clever marsh folk!

burdock.name: Burdock
burdock.who: a faun provisioner; cheerful, shameless about his prices, calls everyone 'my lucky number'; owns Pudding, a goat with a weakness for buckets

lines.text: Don't step on it. It's a mire mimic, mud pretending to be a plank. My hay needs to cross!
Two coins a cake. Or a thank-you, which is also nice.
This has never happened. Tell nobody.

tamsin.name: Tamsin Three-Cards
tamsin.who: Tamsin Three-Cards, a kitsune card-sharp; quick, delighted to be caught, never sore about losing
tamsin.direction: prankster. fun loving, laughs a lot, always upbeat

lines.text: Find the Sun Card, win a place at the front!
Come back when you feel lucky.

tamsin_river_keeper.name: Tamsin
tamsin_river_keeper.who: Tamsin, a griffin who keeps the river line for the aerie above the shore (she/her). Brisk, bossy and kind; counts heads and asks "Is everyone here?" Talks to the river like a naughty dog ("Down, river! Sit!"), and it never listens. Nearly falls off ledges when she waves. Wants the herd's goats and hay safe, and wants to know why the water is above every line her family ever painted.
tamsin_river_keeper.direction: brisk and bossy but kind, calling out from a ledge

lines.text: Fair enough. You've done plenty. I'll tie one here myself, first thing tomorrow.
Somebody hold it, and somebody climb three rungs. Tell me what you see on the cliff.
Hay for the snowhorn herd! That's their winter. If it floats off, it's gone.

wend.name: Wend
wend.who: a Deep Hollow soup ladler; gentle, generous, asks nothing, says 'kindness first' and means it a little too much

lines.text: Everything that hums wants to go home. We'd like to help it get there, all at once.
Since the red night. Means something, doesn't it?
I remember. Soup's still free. Kindness first.

mother_thrum.name: Mother Thrum
mother_thrum.who: a ford witch; careful and instructive, peers over glasses, always asks 'what do you actually want?'

lines.text: That's the Ford Stone. Take it somewhere it stops ringing. I'd like some sleep.
That's the first true thing anyone's said on this hill. I'll ask again. I always do.
I always ask twice. Once at the ford, once at the mountain. What do you actually want?

brackens.name: Brackens
brackens.who: the Brackens, a faun family whose season is over; tired, polite, the littlest one very brave about it

troupe_leader.name: Troupe Leader
troupe_leader.who: a rush-camp actor-manager; grand and dramatic, calls everyone 'darlings', thrilled by any eruption

lines.text: Climb up, darling, and be a MOUNTAIN!
New mountain, darlings!
Annoyingly better.

red_scarves.name: Red Scarves
red_scarves.who: the red-scarf line-cutters' leader; pushy and impatient, but fair when fairly beaten

sefa_tallgrass.name: Sefa Tallgrass
sefa_tallgrass.who: pride elder; voice like warm gravel; formal and kind; says 'east of the river, wave first'; quietly worried about the cubs
sefa_tallgrass.direction: warm gravel, formal, kind, quietly worried

lines.text: Welcome, travelers. Greet us back properly, and you may sit at our fire.
I have tried counting cubs. They keep changing places.
Then they had better come to the fire.

cart_driver.name: Cart Driver
cart_driver.who: a caravan driver from Stone Crossing; indignant about pride escort bookings; very fond of his donkey

road_warden.name: Road Warden
road_warden.who: a road-warden centaur re-embroidering sashes; talks around spools of thread; tuts a great deal; precise about roads

lines.text: The new detours glow in the order the stones fell. Watch, then put them back in order.
Every sash needs changing this season. Help me see why.
River first, then pride, bridge, pride.

bracken_swiftmile.name: Bracken Swiftmile
bracken_swiftmile.who: a relay-running centaur stuffed with letters; quick, cheerful, competitive; 'relay waits for nobody'
bracken_swiftmile.direction: Brash, cheerful, competitive, overly confident, fast-paced

lines.text: News from the west? News going north? Quick. The relay waits for nobody.
Biggest rush in living memory. And all of it humming.
Relay waits for nobody! Anything going south?

manticore_cubs.name: Manticore Cubs
manticore_cubs.who: two manticore cubs who pretend to be rocks; giggly, honest, dream the ground is singing

lines.text: We are rocks.

granny_ash.name: Granny Ash
granny_ash.who: a manticore grandmother with a famous spiced grass-cake nobody finishes; bossy, delighted by everything

lines.text: It's not you, dear. It's whatever is singing in there.
Nobody has ever finished a slice.
For later. Something normal.

marker_movers.name: Marker Movers
marker_movers.who: two polite manticores moving a pride marker post further from the caravans, again

beech_tree.name: Beech Tree
beech_tree.who: old, slow, smells of rain; whispers in long sentences and never raises its voice

lines.text: Passing through. Everybody is passing through. Even me. I am just slower.
Honest. Go gently. The glade is sore, and something there is listening.
I know. The whole forest knows.

elder_unicorn.name: Elder Unicorn
elder_unicorn.who: calm, few words, frowns with her ears; says the important thing once and stops

lines.text: Mend the glade, and the stone sinks back into the ground. Take it, and the glade never mends.
We are mending. Will you help?
Slowly. The forest dislikes hurry. Something in the worst glade listens for loud things. Go quiet, or go so noisy it can't follow.

flood_warden.name: Flood Warden
flood_warden.who: MossHome bigfoot in very tall boots; brisk, practical, has seen every kind of soggy
flood_warden.direction: Slower cadence, low timber, warm and friendly

lines.text: The flooded paths? You're the soggy ones! The whole forest heard! Mind you stay dry.
Happens every season. Not usually to this many.
Proper work.

echo_hunter.name: Echo Hunter
echo_hunter.who: never speaks; tilts its frilled head, listening, filing every sound
echo_hunter.notes: Provisional voice changed from Umbriel to Orus to avoid a chapter-level voice conflict.

runner.name: MossHome Runner
runner.who: a MossHome runner; cheerful, out of breath, never stops jogging even while talking, carries bundles of knotted cords

lines.text: Gullet? Notched hat, hums a lot? She says she's not worried. Which means she is.
Haven't seen a knock like that outside town! MossHome's north. Visit!
MossHome runner! Third missing path today! Help me find it?

boundary_runner.name: Runner
boundary_runner.who: A young dragonling runner from the counting circle (she/her). Out of breath, says everything twice, then sits down on her own feet.
boundary_runner.direction: out of breath, says everything twice

hedge_prospectors.name: Hedge Prospectors
hedge_prospectors.who: prospectors held by a hedge; loud, indignant, then sheepish once their pockets are empty

ma_ruddle.name: Ma Ruddle
ma_ruddle.who: a sold-out prospector; tired, blunt, cares about Tib and nothing else

lines.text: Never mind the wagon. I've lost my nephew Tib! Small. Orange hat. Talks to horses.
For the stone I left at the depot. I'm going home. You have it.
Watch which one he hides behind.

tib.name: Tib
tib.who: a small boy in an orange hat; talks to horses, ponies and centaurs as equals

sergeant_holloway.name: Sergeant Holloway
sergeant_holloway.who: a Skywarden supply sergeant; rigid, honest, calls everything 'arithmetic', writes everything down
sergeant_holloway.direction: flat, precise, slightly fast, hard stops at the end of sentences

lines.text: Arithmetic. The only thing up here that isn't shouting.
The citadel keeps logs. Somebody has to.
Close enough. For arithmetic.

clerk_pennywhistle.name: Clerk Pennywhistle
clerk_pennywhistle.who: a depot clerk; loves forms, horrified by smudges, very sorry about Form 7B

lines.text: The Depot Stone. Claimed. Keep it away from my pens.
Mire mimics! Ten has been empty since spring!
There is a form for deciding which form.

old_corran.name: Old Corran
old_corran.who: an old centaur relay singer; slow, warm, sings more than he speaks

lines.text: There. The road just learned you.
Now tap them back in road order.
The road just learned you.

road_boss.name: Road Boss
road_boss.who: a centaur road-crew boss; brisk and practical, a marker post on each shoulder, says 'a road goes where the walking goes'

lines.text: Nothing will pass the hollow where the stone fell.
My crew will help if the ash wind catches you.
Good work. The relay will sing about this.

map_seller.name: Map Seller
map_seller.who: a map seller in a velvet coat; smooth, cheerful, never technically lies

rumor_ring.name: Rumor Ring
rumor_ring.who: noon-stop travelers swapping news; eager, garbled, every story a little bigger each time

hollis.name: Hollis
hollis.who: a Deep Hollow Cult recruiter with a giant soup pot; gentle, patient, calls everyone 'love'; feeds people before she says anything; sincerely believes the seal is a lid on a cure

lines.text: That's all right, love. Soup's still free.
Eat first, dear. Questions later.
The world's rules are broken, love. The power under the mountain could write new ones. The seal on it isn't a lock. It's a lid on the cure.

pellam.name: Pellam
pellam.who: a Skywarden clerk; dry, precise, logs everything and keeps nothing; 'logged is not owned'; secretly enjoys irregular-but-legal

lines.text: Leash. Holding is harder than asking. You have to know you are choosing it.
Watch them go by, then put them back in order. The captain likes order.
Helping. Fixing. Putting things back. That is a different word from the one you just said.

brask.name: Engineer Brask
brask.who: Skywarden engineer; pencils behind both ears; blunt and honest; talks about arithmetic and acceptable losses but is not unkind
brask.direction: blunt and practical, does sums out loud, never unkind

lines.text: Level to a hair. The approach is sound. It's the middle that worries me.
Seen anything odd on the road? I need it. This drawing makes no sense.
Tell the wardens, and we can use this to run the crossing.

brask_pass_keeper.name: Brask
brask_pass_keeper.who: Brask, the griffin who keeps the aerie's pass ledger (he/him). Slow, precise and secretly soft. Licks his pencil before every word and writes everything down, even "Tea. Good." Calls the party his witnesses. Wants the ledger to be true, because a wrong page sends a herd off a cliff.
brask_pass_keeper.direction: slow and precise, dry, secretly soft

lines.text: So the herd could use it, if the shelf is real. Where does it meet the cairns?
Or roll a stone along it and listen. That takes longer. Listening always does.
A goat could walk it. A goat should walk it on a rope. Now. What do we write?

carter.name: Tired carter
carter.who: a tired caravan driver; has heard gem 4117 hum for nine days; trades for a song; grateful when you catch her crates

lines.text: Nine days those have been humming at me. Nine days. Thank you.
Take it. Give me a song I can sing over it instead.
Not that one. The humming ones are underneath.

nim.name: Nim
nim.who: a dragonling bell-rider on a tiny fast pony called Pepper; quick, proud, a little sassy about her grandmother

lines.text: Grandmother says ponies always know first. She is usually right. It's very annoying.
Only Grandmother can do that. Bell-rider's tip. Don't tell Grandmother.
She'll stand there till Tuesday. Do something nice at her.

tibbet.name: Corporal Tibbet
tibbet.who: Corporal Tibbet, a very new Skywarden guarding the engineers' tent; helmet too big; wants reasons in writing

lines.text: No entry without a pass. Or a good reason. In writing.
Logged goods may pass.

apprentice.name: Apprentice
apprentice.who: an apprentice engineer measuring the crack with knotted string every evening; 'a hair wider than yesterday'

lines.text: A hair wider than yesterday. It's always a hair wider than yesterday.
Pull your end tight just as the knot lines up with the edge. It only reads true when it's tight.
A hair wider than yesterday. Always is.

flag_warden.name: Flag Warden
flag_warden.who: the Skywarden with the flag at the span; asks the troll's question of every cart

lines.text: Where did you get that? And where is it going?
Quick. Light moves.

archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.who: brisk bigfoot archivist; fussy about feet, warm once she decides you matter

lines.text: Don't tell me your road. Show me. Every path that moved under your boots.
That one wants north. Carry it if you like. We will record who has it.
That glade's record changed this morning. It got better. In. Feet.

oldest_archivist.name: Oldest Archivist
oldest_archivist.who: very old, very slow, a bird lives in his beard; talks to the knot-cords as much as to you

lines.text: Did not ask what the forest keeps.
The paths flinched like this long ago. The forest has kept the record all along. The stones are older than the mountain's name.

eldest.name: The Eldest
eldest.who: MossHome elder; mild, sips tea between every sentence, asks to be told second and means it
eldest.direction: mild, unhurried, sips tea between sentences

lines.text: The wardens. They write things down. That is not nothing. Second.
The grandmothers. Tell them we said so. And tell us second.
Nobody yet. When you do tell. Second.

soup_woman.name: Soup Woman
soup_woman.who: a Deep Hollow Cult member; genuinely kind, soft-spoken, believes every word; kindness first, always, and never menacing

lines.text: Whatever sleeps under the mountain could fix the world's rules. We collect to help it wake.
It'll wake so gently.
Soup's still soup.

path_keeper.name: Path Keeper
path_keeper.who: old bigfoot who keeps the halfway hut on the high paths; slow, kind, proud of his visitors' book
path_keeper.direction: slow, kind, proud of his visitors' book

lines.text: Mind the stream past the hut. A young river drake has moved in.
Takes forty years to read those. I've done thirty-one.
Still good advice. There are wolves up there today.

young_gatherer.name: Young Gatherer
young_gatherer.who: a young dragonling gatherer; insists she is not lost, knows the one rule by heart, braver than she feels
young_gatherer.direction: small, brave, insists she is not lost

lines.text: Not lost. Grandmother sent me to the elders. They never go that way.
Even they don't know where to go.
Take what the mountain drops. Never pry at what it holds. Grandmothers say it at every boundary stone. Nobody listens this year.

great_gran_ashby.name: Great-Grandma Ashby
great_gran_ashby.who: the oldest dragonling grandmother; brisk, tender, unarguable, taps things with her walking stick

lines.text: Old rule. Every guest brings something: a story, a recipe, a thing from the road.
Nobody sells what the mountain drops. Now you're keeping it. Not owning it.
Careful is not the same as quiet. But careful is a start.

grandmother.name: Grandmother
grandmother.who: a gate-town grandmother; glasses on a chain, counts everything, hugs first and inspects later

lines.text: Well! Look who came home the FRONT way. Worst season in the tallies, love. Come and help.
That's Thrum's work! Is that old crow still at the ford? Anybody Thrum trusts can skip my socks.
Take what the mountain drops. Never pry at what it holds.

bell_code_expert.name: Bell Code Expert
bell_code_expert.who: a bell-code expert aged about six; talks at top speed until the unrung bell comes up

lines.text: Nobody rings that one. Not ever. Great-Grandma says we'll know.
One ring. Moths leaving. Every night this month.
But never this many. And they haven't come back.

perrin.name: Perrin Nine-Verse
perrin.who: Perrin Nine-Verse, a centaur guide; conspiratorial, emotional, desperate the Shortcut stays an argument

lines.text: Good! The argument lives. My grandfather would be furious if it ended on a Tuesday.
There's a Shortcut through the hills. My family has argued about it for nine generations. Will you walk it?
Never tell anyone. It's the best argument we've got.

feathered_hat.name: Feathered Hat
feathered_hat.who: a loud prospector on a cart; blustering, sure the stones are just old rocks, quiet once he really listens

hessa.name: Hessa Wren
hessa.who: Hessa Wren, Deep Hollow Cult cell contact running a soup tent; warm, generous, remembers every name, completely certain the seal is a cage on the cure
hessa.direction: bright, high-pitched, straining to talk, childish pronunciation, a lisp

lines.text: We'll buy what you traded for here, so we can break the seal properly, and fix it.
Wend sends love to everybody, but Wend did say your names.
Warm-up. I hum, you hum back. No giggling at the low one.

voss.name: Captain Voss
voss.who: Captain Orla Voss of the Skywardens; rigid, honest, never wastes a word, says 'acceptable losses' as calmly as ordering breakfast
voss.direction: rigid, honest, never wastes a word

lines.text: Who should stand with you now? The wardens, the grandmothers' towns, or nobody else yet?
A starting road, then. You can carry a question as well as a plan.
Pockets. A great many pockets. Nobody can say you didn't warn us.

grandmother_tull.name: Grandmother Tull
grandmother_tull.who: Grandmother Tull, dragonling bell-keeper; brisk, cozy, says 'nothing to worry about' one time too many

lines.text: The ridge watch knows this one. Ring it at the gate and they'll notice you.
That one is nothing to worry about.
Nothing to worry about.

dunmore.name: Dunmore
dunmore.who: Dunmore, a prospector with a pick and no sense; embarrassed easily, means well

lines.text: Nobody told me.

claim_pair.name: Claim Pair
claim_pair.who: two prospectors sharing one humming boulder; stubborn, then sheepish, and hungry the whole time

lines.text: Everything that hums goes in a numbered box.
Only been in there since Tuesday.

caravan_master.name: Caravan Master
caravan_master.who: exhausted, practical, will sell to whoever stops shouting first

lines.text: Is that a bell? It's the saddest bell I've ever heard.
Please keep it. It's been humming at me for a month.
No point haggling with somebody who's read my post.

brisk.name: Brisk
brisk.who: Brisk, a centaur relay runner; fast-talking, fair, says a lot by saying nothing

lines.text: News, if you want it. Everybody up there is doing something. Without you.
Nobody knows much. The wardens are guessing. The masks are singing. Everybody's waiting for somebody to do something.
The wardens did what you told them. Checkpoints on every road. Every stone logged twice. It's ugly, but they're holding.

brisk.notes: Re-audition required: Pulcherrima was approved previously, but overlaps another speaker in this character's chapters. Original approval retained in history; Autonoe is a provisional alternative.

bryony.name: Bryony
bryony.who: a dragonling girl who keeps the price board at the Pinch; chalky, quick, nosy, cheerful

lines.text: Only three of the big ones. Everybody starts somewhere.
Humming pebbles. Everybody starts with those.
Nobody has three!

lady_fleecewick.name: Lady Fleecewick
lady_fleecewick.who: a rival collector, a sheeple in a lace collar with a glass cabinet on wheels; gracious, thrilled by any stone, never sore about losing
lady_fleecewick.direction: gracious, thrilled, never sore about losing

lines.text: Collector's courtesy. Don't spend it all on honeycakes.
three of the real ones. A lovely start, dear.
Humming pebbles. Mine started that way too.

alder.name: Alder
alder.who: a boy on a milestone selling his one stone for the wagon home; polite, hopeful, trying hard to be grown-up

lines.text: Then I'll keep mine till I'm bigger, and come back for my own.

dragonling_runner.name: Dragonling Runner
dragonling_runner.who: a young dragonling runner carrying bell news between the gathering towns; quick and earnest

stall_witch.name: Stall Witch
stall_witch.who: patched hat, brisk, charms ringing around her; lends questions, never sells them
stall_witch.direction: brisk, patient, a warm sales smile

lines.text: Answer my question first, and I'll lend it to you. What do you actually want?
Honest. I'll give you honest. Ask it of yourselves first.
No. That's not a want. That's a wish for a want.

linnet.name: Cadet Linnet
linnet.who: Cadet Linnet, a young warden scout; keen, stiff, trying to look older, softens fast

lines.text: Tell him it's evidence!

linnet.notes: Provisional voice changed from Sadachbia to Puck to avoid a chapter-level voice conflict.

rook.name: Rook
rook.who: Rook, a young mask scout from the choir; prickly, quick, curious under it

lines.text: It's the same stone.
Tell her it's ours!

warden_sergeant.name: Warden Sergeant
warden_sergeant.who: rigid, honest, tired; counts everything; secretly hates making children cry
warden_sergeant.direction: flat and tired, counts everything, kind underneath

lines.text: Road's closed.

warden_sergeant.notes: Provisional voice changed from Orus to Algieba to avoid a chapter-level voice conflict.

odo.name: Odo
odo.who: a cheerful man with a wheelbarrow of painted gravel he believes is gems; proud, easily delighted, never sulks

lines.text: Well. Gravel doesn't sing at night, I suppose.
Never carried anything worth this much.
Keeps me up at night. Singing.

posy.name: Corbin and Posy
posy.who: Corbin the prospector's small daughter; serious, brave, thinks hard before she answers

lines.text: It kept humming at night. I think it was asking. You take it home.
It's my lucky one. It's going to make us rich.
So it can go home.

seal_keeper.name: Seal Keeper
seal_keeper.who: the Seal-Keeper, the legend dragon under Mount Red Sky; ancient, unhurried, dry as ash, asks questions it already knows the answers to, grades generously when surprised and is very rarely surprised

lines.text: They have been telling everyone for a thousand years. Finally, somebody listened.
They write everything down twice. They notice. They do not climb. You climbed.
Honestly? We came to get rich. At last. Everybody else says they came for me.

bones.name: Bones
bones.who: the restless remains; do not speak, but nod, sigh and settle

titan.name: Titan
titan.who: the titan under the seal; never described or explained, only witnessed: a great sleepy eye, a warm breath, and the old note the stones hum, which the Seal-Keeper puts into words; curious, slow and never angry

bryn.name: Bryn
bryn.who: Bryn, a dragonling bridge-mender (she/her). Gruff and proud, and puts the important word first: "Planks, I have. Hands, I do not." Pats beams like ponies. Wants her bridge whole by market day.

lines.text: That pile has been there since dawn. I think it is breathing.
No rock like that for a hundred miles. My grandmother said the bridge was built on it. It was here first.
Kindling. For calling goats. They ignore it.

tilly.name: Tilly
tilly.who: Tilly, a griffin egg farmer taking duck eggs to market (she/her). Worried, kind and a little dramatic. Counts her eggs, loses count, counts again. Wants her eggs to wait until market. They do not.
tilly.direction: worried, dramatic, counts and loses count

lines.text: That one has picked you. They do that. It may go with you, if you like.
I'm Tilly. Duck eggs, for market across the river. They aren't due for days. They disagree.
That bump at the dock. It woke them up early.

saltrot_guide.name: Puddle
saltrot_guide.who: Puddle, the Skupper guide (she/her). Quick, chatty and cheerfully blunt. Guides from brackish pools and channels and signals with her tall crest; puffs up round when startled. Fits exactly in a puddle, hence the name. Keeps her lunch in a floating box. Wants her channel back and to know whose ruins have landed on it.

lines.text: Rule says leave before the tide turns. But I've always wanted to see them move.
When the wave reaches me, shout NOW and I pull. Too soon, and it only splashes.
Guides keep an account of everything that comes and goes here. This belongs in it.

pip_thistledown.name: Pip Thistledown
pip_thistledown.who: Young manticore scout (he/him). Eager, notebook always out, quotes "Lady Olivia says..." and tries her ideas. Wants a sample to impress her. Kind underneath; changes his mind when the party gives him a reason.
pip_thistledown.direction: voice cracking, some words deep and some high, but confident

lines.text: Lady Olivia says a real scout goes first. And you stood with her. So I will too.
Lady Olivia says a good scout saves the most important thing. Which one was it?
Lady Olivia would bang some pots and shoo it out the far tunnel. Done by lunch!

tally.name: Tally
tally.who: Tally, the dragonling who keeps the boundary stones above the river and the counting stones up the road (she/her). Brisk, cheerful and exact. Counts everything out loud, under her breath: stones, cups, steps, ducks, visitors. Loses count only when she is worried, and then starts again from one. Thanks every stone by name. Wants the count kept true: a counter's stones must never move, and hers have. Pays her helpers in cake.
tally.direction: brisk, exact, counts aloud, faster when upset

lines.text: Kettle saved. The river has no idea how to make tea. Mosslight. For work at dusk.
An eruption. Our oldest counts can't agree when it was. Nobody's count matches.
My cousins and I will roll it somewhere sensible. Tomorrow. With a lot of cousins.

orin_vale.name: Master Orin Vale
orin_vale.who: Griffin scholar and Riftseeker (he/him). Kind, dusty, delighted by evidence and a little sad about sandwiches. Wants to understand before anyone forces anything.

lines.text: A long pole and a small stone, and you can lift a mountain. Or at least a sled.
Ice nobody has tested? Let us mark a safe bank first, even if it takes till dark.
Why is the river on the wrong side of the mountain? It was never on that side.

pebble.name: Pebble
pebble.who: Pebble, Brask's young apprentice (she/her). Small, quick and nervous, with an inky beak. Drew this season's page and is afraid she drew it wrong. Counts in griffin, which has different numbers. Brave once she has a reason.
pebble.direction: small, nervous, quick, a little squeaky

lines.text: Griffins learn a page by heart, in case the book gets wet. Watch twice, then tap it back.
Herders, with their goats. They'll want to know if this path is real.
It was true when I drew it. Now it's true again. Nervous packing.

olivia.name: Lady Olivia
olivia.who: She/her, unicorn. Bright, certain, kind underneath; wants to use the openings to help people. Surprised by limits, never punished for disagreeing.
olivia.direction: confident, almost villian-like power behind words

lines.text: A harbor, joined to a mountain? Just like that? Imagine what else could be joined!
There you are! You helped me at the whale road. You know I'm not reckless.
You helped me at the whale road. And now you've told me no. I suppose friends do both.

olivia.notes: Re-audition required: Erinome was approved previously, but overlaps another speaker in this character's chapters. Original approval retained in history; Zephyr is a provisional alternative.

bram_lock.name: Bram Lock
bram_lock.who: He/him, bigfoot guard. Short practical requests, dry jokes, never orders the party. Protects Orin, mostly from his own ideas.

lines.text: Help me stop her. Before it pulls somebody in.
Real scouts go first, when it's their turn!
If anything goes wrong tonight, I have a signal. Two claps and a stomp. It means stop. Everybody stops. Even unicorns.

bram_lock.notes: Re-audition required: Charon was approved previously, but overlaps another speaker in this character's chapters. Original approval retained in history; Orus is a provisional alternative.

seren_wisp.name: Seren Wisp
seren_wisp.who: She/her, kitsune. Gentle teacher. Holds a condition, never changes where an opening goes.

lines.text: Every rift hums. A starweaver can learn to answer one. That is called Attune.
Listen for a tick. Listen for a hum. A hum that holds still can be learned.
It's in a hurry. It will last until you have packed, and not a minute more.

thimble.name: Captain Thimble
thimble.who: Chapter-scoped kitsune Sky Island captain, practical and brisk. Frustrated with a displaced island, kind to helpers. No explanation for the displacement.

lines.text: The wind comes from between those crates. Wind should have more room than that.
Never trust a map on a windy day. If you ever reach the islands, look for my washing.
I need a safe lane home for them, and a very strong cup of tea.

the_gull.name: The gull
the_gull.who: Indignant, literal, chilly. Brief complaints; never explains the magic.

lines.text: Best thing all day. Hoofprints! Little ones! That way! Don't tell the other gulls I said thank you.
Hmph. You are the only ones doing anything about this snow. I might come along. To keep an eye on you.
Cold. Still cold. That is the wind. Not my stomach.

fish_seller.name: Fish seller
fish_seller.who: Practical, protective of fish and helpers. Short dockside speech.

lines.text: Something stepped off that patch of grass. Little hooves. Went that way.
Nobody lost a fish, but I lost count. Something stepped off that grass. Little hooves. Went that way.
Gently! They have had a very confusing morning.

barge_pilot.name: Barge pilot
barge_pilot.who: Frogfolk barge pilot (he/him). Fussy, kind, talks to his barge. Lost his landing steps this morning and wants them back. Not Old Ossley.
barge_pilot.direction: Loud, obnoxious, doesn't care who is in the room

lines.text: For the river. It keeps your feet sure on wet boards. Now, where did my landing go?
Pass the sacks friend to friend. And mind the puddles. Potatoes hate puddles.
Six crews eating tonight. Mosslight. It glows when it's happy. Still need a way home.

noodle_seller.name: Noodle seller
noodle_seller.who: She/her. Brisk, generous, talks to her soup pot as if it were a sulky pet.
noodle_seller.direction: brisk, generous, talks to her pot

lines.text: For later. Don't tell the pot. The pot thinks everything is for the pot.
First, I need hands! This awning is heavy, and I pay in coins.
Corners first. Any knot you like, as long as it holds.

corvane.name: Corvane
corvane.who: He/him, an enormous old faun king, newly awake after a thousand years. Confused above all, courtly, patient and sad. Certain about how things should be, bewildered by how they are. Calls places 'my river', 'my bridge'. Never threatens; never says conquer, punish, servants, destroy or hurt.

lines.text: Thank you. It has been a very long time since anyone asked me anything.
Reeds. A wooden bridge. My mother's boat. Someone else's mother.
Wake me if the rivers ever forget their way.

corvane.notes: Provisional voice changed from Charon to Schedar to avoid a chapter-level voice conflict.

yeti_herder.name: Yeti herder
yeti_herder.who: She/her, the yeti who took the party in on their first night. Patient, dry humor, practical cold-weather care.

lines.text: Harbor slush? Then that is where my snow went. The glacier keeps surprising me.
Three coins a pair. Quickest laces on the glacier. Or sit and be warm for free.
Not again. I'll fetch it and take it home. Or you can, and I'll stay with you.

young_yeti_singer.name: Young yeti singer
young_yeti_singer.who: Learns and listens; no lore lecture.

lines.text: You hummed at the door! I heard you. You are halfway to the low song already.
Stand here. Hum from your boots.

skerry.name: Skerry
skerry.who: She/her, the griffin who keeps the iron rings on the ice shelf. Flies above the river the whole way, calling down. Brisk, warm, a little dramatic; cannot lift the party and hates that.
skerry.direction: brisk, warm, a little dramatic, calling from above

lines.text: My mother's! She lost it the year I hatched. Keep it. It wants a brave moment.
It's breathing. Let's watch a while. If we know its breath, we know when to cross.
Good morning, Grumble. I name them all. Grumble has held this wall for fifty winters.

elder_murmur.name: Elder Murmur
elder_murmur.who: Elder Murmur, the very old yeti who keeps the reading room (she/her). Whispers everything, even her jokes. Slow as a snowdrift, never hurries and never guesses. Drinks her tea with ice in it and blows on it to make it colder. Wants to read the memory ice without waking it.
elder_murmur.direction: whispering, very slow, very old, gentle

lines.text: Memory ice. It keeps what it saw when it froze. We read it. We never make it show.
Or wait. Old ice clears if you are still and patient. It takes a long, cold while.
You crossed high, over the rocks. Good. High eyes see the shape of a valley.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.who: Flurry, a young yeti keeper (she/her). Quick, nervous and kind. Knits little striped hats for icicles. Will keep the new reading room the builders are carving, and worries a moving river might come into it.

lines.text: If a river remembers the way it used to go, could it come back? Into my new room?
Maybe the wyrm wants to go back through. But what's on the other side?
Or we help it through the opening to the hollow. It would need its nest, though. My blankets.

grandmother_winkle.name: Grandmother Winkle
grandmother_winkle.who: Puddle's grandmother (she/her), a strict old Skupper guide. Short words, big frown, kind underneath. Keeps the guides' rule: show the bank, never the stone.

lines.text: Good manners. Upriver is a bridge with no river. Guides have one rule for it: show the bank, never the stone.
And a guide, finishes digging her own door.
Silt comes from where water comes from. Upriver is a bridge with no river. Guides have one rule for it: show the bank, never the stone.

dab.name: Dab
dab.who: A small Skupper child (she/her). Licks things to learn about them. Puffs up when startled.

lines.text: Sorry. This morning I saw old stone posts upriver, where the pale silt starts. And it was snowing on them. Just on them.
Thanks. This morning I saw old stone posts upriver, where the pale silt starts. And it was snowing on them. Just on them.

fen.name: Fen
fen.who: A frogfolk fisher (she/her). Brisk, practical, always carrying a fish bag the gulls follow.

lines.text: For luck on soft ground. It warms up over firm mud.
Snow fish! I've never caught a snow fish!
Snow fish don't exist anyway. Probably.

keeper_sorrel.name: Keeper Sorrel
keeper_sorrel.who: Keeper Sorrel, the kitsune temple keeper (she/her). Brisk, kind and unflappable; hooks an arm through a rope ring whenever the wind blows, which is always. Ties her scarf on top of things to read the wind. Wants her island back where it belongs and her travelers off the edge.

lines.text: Point at it every time it sounds. If most of you agree, we have a true bearing.
This held us beside our neighbors for three hundred years. Last night it snapped.
There. Now the sky can find us. One loud note, for when the sky must hear you.

keeper_clove.name: Keeper Clove
keeper_clove.who: Keeper Clove, the Squall Temple's kitsune keeper (he/him). Fussy, kind and brave when it counts; glasses always fogged, teapot always in hand, keeps a weather book. Has never met an island. Wants the bell rung and every keeper dry.
keeper_clove.direction: fussy, kind, brave when it counts

lines.text: The other islands won't hear our warning tonight. But my keepers are dry.
Every keeper who reads this book will watch the sky a little harder now.
I write one line about every storm. What should tonight's line be?

tumble.name: Tumble
tumble.who: Tumble, a young griffin island courier (she/her). Fast, cheerful and terrible at landing; carries letters and messages between the islands.

lines.text: No flying till they're dry. Wet letters stick to my feathers.
I owe you. Need a message carried? Anything at all?
Squall Temple. Easy. It's big and it rings.

farmer_gourd.name: Farmer Gourd
farmer_gourd.who: Round dragonling turnip farmer (he/him). Cheerful and in a hurry; wants his turnips over the hill before they go soft. His goat Mustard eats everything.

lines.text: Roll through between the tugs, or carry my turnips around by hand. Slow, but safe.
Somebody downhill is getting turnips.
That is not helping.

keeper_juniper.name: Keeper Juniper
keeper_juniper.who: Keeper Juniper, the kitsune island keeper (she/her). Brisk, warm and practical; sings instructions, keeps the island songs on a scroll tied to her tail, talks to islands as if they can hear. Wants Notchbrow home safe and to know why it came early.
keeper_juniper.direction: brisk, warm, sing-song when giving instructions

lines.text: If I do it right, she'll let me ring it! I could use a scout who can count, too.
I need to know which side it will touch, so the landing board is waiting there.
Something out there turns them. I can't leave my whales to go and look. Will you?

route_worker_yeti.name: Hummock
route_worker_yeti.who: Hummock, the yeti route worker (he/him). Enormous, slow and kind; says "Steady on"; names every rock on his route and thaws his frozen eyebrows in his tea. Keeps the markers and the warning post on the valley road. Wants the evening sled warned and to know where his river has gone.
route_worker_yeti.direction: slow, rumbling, kind, a gentle giant

lines.text: I've never seen it, but my marker has. That wavy line was right all along.
with soup for the reading room. What is that river doing in my valley?
Big as a sled. Tail by the water, point up the safe path.

grandma_drift.name: Grandma Drift
grandma_drift.who: Yeti grandmother who drives the evening sled from the singing hall (she/her). Brisk and warm; wears a scarf three times her length; remembers old stories.

lines.text: My grandmother told a story about a river that got lost. I thought it was just a story.
This soup has to reach the reading room tonight. Hot.
Grandma Drift.

yeti_builders.name: Yeti builders
yeti_builders.who: The glacier builders, a big gentle crew of yetis. Speak slowly, mostly about ice. Proud of their carving, fond of oat cakes, secretly scared of the wyrm.
yeti_builders.direction: slow, deep, gentle, a crew speaking together

lines.text: Or these. They're scratchy, and they smell of us. It might not like them.
Shooing is loud, and the old ice is close. Moving it is slow.
Lovely hollow on the other side. But the opening flickered while I was in it, on and off, like a candle.
Griffin couriers carry so many letters, they can barely fly.
Rush prices!

gull.name: Gull
gull.who: the harbor gull from the docks, Gemfall's side of the one harbor gull (Riftlight's is "The gull"); only screeches here, never says sorry

silver_otter.name: Silver otter
silver_otter.who: a silver otter from the mimic ditch; playful and a little pleased with itself; only chatters

mother_bracken.name: Mother Bracken
mother_bracken.notes: Provisional voice changed from Pulcherrima to Kore to avoid a chapter-level voice conflict.

lines.text: We are being very brave.
Nobody's. Nobody's.
That hedge is new!

bell_courier.name: Bell Courier

lines.text: You're from the hills! The grandmothers will want YOU.
The grandmothers are turning back pry bars at the boundary stones. Whole wagons of them. Not spoons. Spoons are fine.
She wants a fuss. Any fuss will do.

bell_courier.notes: Re-audition required: Achernar was approved previously, but overlaps another speaker in this character's chapters. Original approval retained in history; Erinome is a provisional alternative.

lines.text: Worked anyway.

carters_mule.name: Carter's mule
carters_mule.notes: Provisional voice changed from Sadachbia to Zubenelgenubi to avoid a chapter-level voice conflict.

lines.text: Toll refund. Do not ask which toll.
I'll pull, you push! On my heave!
Off the road, you silly coals!
Show us what the road taught you. Then we'll show you what the logs say.

masked_choir_singer.name: Masked choir singer

lines.text: For luck. Don't tell the others I'm soft.

masked_choir_singer.notes: Re-audition required: Leda was approved previously, but overlaps another speaker in this character's chapters. Original approval retained in history; Vindemiatrix is a provisional alternative.

lines.text: Better.
Peep.

duckling.name: Duckling
duckling.who: one small duckling that picks the party; only peeps

lines.text: Bless you. It does that when it sees something new.
Back at the Academy! Mind the homework.
Anyone may try it on.
Wipe your feet.
Good crate.
My herd keeps stopping on the east ridge. Ears up, all pointing one way. Something under the ice is ticking. I want to know what, before a goat finds it first. Will you help me look?
Under, then. Mind the puddles. They are very cold puddles.
Don't go near it. It's been pulling things since dawn.
You saved my fish. Let us save that little one!

aunt_bellow.name: Aunt Bellow
aunt_bellow.direction: Condescending, short, only says the words she needs to say

lines.text: The cactus never turns. Keep singing.
Back to the Conservatory? Good.
Anyone may try it on.

spotted_kid.name: Spotted kid
spotted_kid.who: a younger kid goat from the yeti herder's herd, white with brown spots and extra wiggly; not the Goat kid the party brought home; only bleats

lines.text: It will not fold.
It looks comfortable. Good. A neighbor who sleeps all winter is a quiet neighbor.
Ah. The road went wrong. I did not. You saved my cart. Wave these, and the whole sky will see.
Ah. Wrong road. Wave these, and the whole sky will see.
The Cairnstep watchers told me where you landed. They said to look after you.
I fly ahead and wave. If I wave two, hold on to something.
Not without the whales' answer. The ferry, then.
This school is called the Dojo. Here we train the Thornguard, a hero who holds the line.
That is how you brace. Stand still, and let it come.
Back already? Good.
Thank you! I'll tell the whole market a stone went for a walk!
Thank you! Every last turnip!
